<!-- Included by report.qmd. Shares its params. Spatial block CV across mesh cutoffs.
`sum_loglik` is a SUMMED hold-out log-likelihood, which is only comparable because every
cutoff here scores the same observations. Do not carry that metric over to a comparison whose
candidates differ in size -- see knowledge/model-selection.md and sdmTMB_cv_summary(). -->

```{r cv-section, eval=params$include_cv}
#| output: asis
cat("## Cross-validation\n\n")
fit_total <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
mcv <- sdmTMB_mesh_cv(fit_total, mesh_cutoffs = c(40, 60, 80, 100), k = 3)  # needs blockCV
print(plot(mcv, metric = "sum_loglik"))
```
